props.title: Outreach Teams
props.description: Serving Grand Rapids — the food, the neighbors, and the days our city already turns out for.

props.heading: Outreach Teams
props.lede: We are planted in Grand Rapids and we seek the good of the city around us. Outreach is how we serve the street outside.

props.heading: Grand Rapids is the assignment too.
props.subline: A few times a year, and some of it every week
props.body:
We are planted in this city to seek its best. An Outreach Team is a group from New Life going somewhere in Grand Rapids to do something useful. We take groceries to a neighbor or run the food truck. We also show up on the days the neighborhood is already outside.

Some of this work happens one big day a year. Some of it happens every week. We share the weekly schedule so nobody does it alone. You do not need a special skill to come. You just need to be free that day.

facts.label: Who can come
facts.value: Anyone — families welcome, kids included on most of it

facts.label: The weekly ones
facts.value: Grocery deliveries and the food truck, on a rota

facts.label: Partners
facts.value: Serve GR, the Grand Rapids Dream Center, and our own neighbors

cards.title: Meals of Hope
cards.text: One November afternoon, hundreds of people, two hours, thousands of packed meals. Kids scoop, teens seal, adults weigh.

cards.title: Serve GR
cards.text: We partner with Serve GR for a summer outreach day across the city.

cards.title: National Night Out
cards.text: Showing up in August on the night the neighborhoods are already out on their porches.

cards.title: Grocery deliveries and the food truck
cards.text: Every Sunday after service, groceries go out with the Grand Rapids Dream Center to neighbors who need them, and the food truck goes where it is needed. Seventeen people are on the rota, mostly couples, so your turn comes around every couple of months — an hour, once in a while.

props.title: The need is on our street.
props.body:
It is easier to care about a place you fly to than the place you drive through. Overseas missions have a departure date and a photo at the end. A neighbor two blocks away has neither.

So we put our own city on the calendar the same way we put the Caribbean on it. We schedule the dates and we build the teams so that someone is responsible for showing up.

props.title: Tell us you're in.
props.body: Tell us you are in. We will let you know the next date, where to be, and what we are doing. Come to one or come to all of them.

cards.label: To the local church
cards.title: Ambassador Teams
cards.body: One Sunday a month we worship at another Grand Rapids church, having prayed for them all month, and hand over a letter and a gift.

cards.label: To our partners overseas
cards.title: Missions Teams
cards.body: A week in the Caribbean with Mission of Hope — medical care, kids clubs, construction, whatever the team is built to do.
